def events():
            policy = collector.options.get('sw55_policy')
            window = policy.get('log_coverage') if isinstance(policy, dict) else None
            if (not isinstance(policy, dict) or policy.get('scope') != scope or policy.get('status') != 'collected' or
                    not isinstance(window, dict) or window.get('status') != 'collected'):
                raise ReadError('unavailable', 'provider_access_window_unresolved')
            start_text, end_text = _timestamp(window.get('start')), _timestamp(window.get('end'))
            start, end = (datetime.fromisoformat(v.replace('Z', '+00:00')) for v in (start_text, end_text))
            if not start < end <= datetime.fromisoformat(collector.read_time) or end - start > timedelta(days=31):
                raise ReadError('unavailable', 'provider_access_window_invalid_or_unbounded')
            start_text, end_text = start.isoformat(), end.isoformat()
            log = scope + '/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Faccess_transparency'
            expression = f'logName="{log}" AND timestamp>="{start_text}" AND timestamp<"{end_text}"'
            body = {'resourceNames': [scope], 'filter': expression, 'orderBy': 'timestamp desc',
                    'pageSize': min(collector.page_size, 1000)}
            seen = {}
            for page, request_id in collector.pages('https://logging.googleapis.com/v2/entries:list', scope,
                    key='entries', method='POST', page_size_key=None, body=body):
                if not page:
                    yield [], request_id
                for row in page:
                    projected = []
                    payload, insert = row.get('jsonPayload'), row.get('insertId')
                    if (row.get('logName') != log or not isinstance(insert, str) or not insert or len(insert) > 1024 or
                            not isinstance(payload, dict) or
                            payload.get('@type') != 'type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.audit.TransparencyLog'):
                        raise ReadError('malformed', 'provider_access_log_identity_or_type_unverified')
                    at_text = _timestamp(row.get('timestamp'))
                    at = datetime.fromisoformat(at_text.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
                    if not start <= at < end:
                        raise ReadError('malformed', 'provider_access_log_outside_window')
                    accesses = payload.get('accesses')
                    approvals = payload.get('accessApprovals', [])
                    if (not isinstance(accesses, list) or not accesses or len(accesses) > 256 or
                            any(not isinstance(a, dict) for a in accesses) or not isinstance(approvals, list) or
                            any(not isinstance(a, str) or not re.fullmatch(re.escape(scope) + r'/approvalRequests/[^/]+', a)
                                for a in approvals) or len(approvals) != len(set(approvals))):
                        raise ReadError('malformed', 'provider_access_scope_or_approval_join_unresolved')
                    for ordinal, access in enumerate(accesses):
                        resource = access.get('resourceName')
                        match = re.fullmatch(r'//([a-z0-9.-]+\.googleapis\.com)/(.*)', resource or '')
                        if (match is None or not (match[2] == scope or match[2].startswith(scope + '/')) or
                                not isinstance(access.get('methodName'), str) or not access['methodName']):
                            raise ReadError('unavailable', 'provider_access_service_or_resource_unresolved')
                        item = {'name': log + '/entries/' + quote(insert, safe='') + '/accesses/' + str(ordinal),
                                'timestamp': at_text, 'serviceName': match[1], 'resourceName': match[2],
                                'principal': 'Google personnel (individual identity not disclosed)',
                                'principalIdentityDisclosed': False, 'provider_access': True,
                                'classificationSource': 'google.cloud.audit.TransparencyLog',
                                'approvalRequests': approvals}
                        if item['name'] in seen and seen[item['name']] != item:
                            raise ReadError('malformed', 'provider_access_log_identity_conflict')
                        seen[item['name']] = item
                        projected.append(item)
                    yield projected, request_id

def project_log_entry(row, scope, project_aliases=None):
    """Audit metadata only; omitted/redacted actors remain unclassified.

    No request/response/text/JSON payload or caller credentials survive. An
    observed row is not a claim about log retention or unobserved events.
    """
    from .gcp import ReadError
    log, insert = row.get('logName'), row.get('insertId')
    prefix = scope + '/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2F'
    if (not isinstance(log, str) or log not in (prefix + 'activity', prefix + 'data_access', prefix + 'policy')
            or not isinstance(insert, str) or not insert or len(insert) > 1024):
        raise ReadError('malformed', 'audit_metadata_identity_mismatch')
    payload = row.get('protoPayload')
    if not isinstance(payload, dict) or payload.get('@type') != 'type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.audit.AuditLog':
        raise ReadError('malformed', 'audit_metadata_payload_type_mismatch')
    resource = row.get('resource', {})
    if not isinstance(resource, dict) or not isinstance(resource.get('labels', {}), dict):
        raise ReadError('malformed', 'audit_metadata_resource_malformed')
    project = resource.get('labels', {}).get('project_id')
    if project is not None and project not in (project_aliases or {scope.split('/')[1]}):
        raise ReadError('malformed', 'audit_metadata_foreign_project')
    auth = payload.get('authenticationInfo')
    principal = auth.get('principalEmail') if isinstance(auth, dict) else None
    projected = {'name': log + '/entries/' + quote(insert, safe=''), 'logName': log, 'insertId': insert,
                 'eventClass': 'authenticated_audit' if isinstance(principal, str) and principal.strip() else 'unclassified_audit',
                 'protoPayload': {key: data for key, data in payload.items() if key in ('@type', 'serviceName', 'methodName')},
                 'auditCoverage': {'absence_proves_no_event': False, 'retention_verified': False, 'representation': 'metadata'}}
    if 'timestamp' in row: projected['timestamp'] = row['timestamp']
    if isinstance(auth, dict):
        projected['protoPayload']['authenticationInfo'] = {key: data for key, data in auth.items() if key == 'principalEmail'}
    return projected

def finish(self):
        from peaso.snapshot import make_snapshot
        envelopes, hierarchy_discovery = [], []
        for key, collection in sorted(self.collections.items()):
            if key[1] == "discovery":
                # Search results only resolve scopes; each project/folder/org is
                # inventoried and evaluated once, in its own scope.
                hierarchy_discovery.append({"type": key[0], "status": collection.get("status"),
                    "coverage_status": collection.get("coverage_status"), "resource_count": len(collection["items"]),
                    "error": collection.get("error"), "source_requests": collection.get("source_requests", [])})
                continue
            if (key[0] in self.wanted or key[0] == "project" and
                    (self.options.get("all_projects") or key[1] in getattr(self, "proven_project_alias_scopes", set())
                     or key[1] in getattr(self, "proven_api_key_alias_scopes", set()))):
                collection["items"].sort(key=lambda item: item["_resource_id"])
                envelopes.append(collection)
        metadata = {"collection": "read-only", "collector": "native-gcp", "requested_scopes": self.requested_scopes,
            "resolved_scopes": self.scopes, "inherited_scopes": getattr(self, "inherited_scopes", []),
            "auth_method": getattr(getattr(self.transport, "credentials", None), "method", selected_auth_method(self.auth)),
            "calls": getattr(self.transport, "calls", 0), "max_calls": self.max_calls, "max_pages": self.max_pages,
            "max_resources": self.max_items, "max_scopes": self.max_scopes, "concurrency": self.workers, "asset_read_time": self.read_time,
            "intentional_limits": {key: self.options[key] for key in ("max_calls", "max_pages", "max_resources", "max_scopes", "deadline_seconds")
                                   if self.options.get(key) is not None},
            "collection_mode": "intentionally_limited" if any(self.options.get(key) is not None for key in
                ("max_calls", "max_pages", "max_resources", "max_scopes", "deadline_seconds")) else "full",
            "omitted_inventories": sorted(SUPPORTED_TYPES - self.wanted), "supporting_inventories": sorted(self.needed - self.wanted),
            "source_requests": getattr(self.transport, "evidence", []), "scope_coverage": self.scope_errors,
            "hierarchy_discovery": hierarchy_discovery,
            "scope_type_omissions": {kind: sorted(types) for kind, types in sorted(getattr(self, "scope_type_omissions", {}).items())},
            "project_restrictions": sorted(self.allowed) if self.allowed is not None else None,
            "trusted_scope_ids": self.options.get("trusted_scope_ids", []),
            "trusted_domains": self.options.get("trusted_domains", []),
            "trusted_domains_explicit": "trusted_domains" in self.options,
            "trusted_users": self.options.get("trusted_users"),
            "trusted_groups": self.options.get("trusted_groups"),
            "trusted_service_accounts": self.options.get("trusted_service_accounts"),
            "service_usage_selection": ["*"],
            "service_usage_mode": "complete_list",
            "cloudbuild_location_selection": self.options.get("cloudbuild_locations"),
            "cloudbuild_location_mode": "selected" if "cloudbuild_locations" in self.options else "discovered",
            "limitations": ["CAI is eventually consistent; direct API reads are collected at their request time",
                "Audit absence never proves inactivity; disabled/denied Data Access logging limits activity evidence",
                "IAM policies and conditions are declared grants, not an effective-access decision",
                "Shared VPC references outside selected projects are not traversed"]}
        if {"firewall_policy", "firewall_policy_association"} <= self.wanted:
            projects = [scope for scope in self.scopes if scope.startswith("projects/")]
            evidence = []
            unaffected_projects = []
            project_ancestors = {}
            for project_scope in projects:
                ancestry = self.ancestry.get(project_scope)
                ancestry_request = self.ancestry_source_requests.get(project_scope)
                if (not isinstance(ancestry, list) or not ancestry or not ancestry_request or
                    not isinstance(ancestry[0], dict) or not isinstance(ancestry[0].get("resourceId"), dict) or
                    ancestry[0]["resourceId"].get("type") != "project" or
                    any(not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("resourceId"), dict) or
                        item["resourceId"].get("type") not in ("folder", "organization") or
                        not isinstance(item["resourceId"].get("id"), str) or
                        not item["resourceId"]["id"].isdigit() for item in ancestry[1:]) or
                    any(item["resourceId"]["type"] == "organization" for item in ancestry[1:-1])):
                    continue
                project_evidence = [{"path": f"projects/{project_scope.split('/', 1)[1]}:getAncestry",
                    "source_requests": [ancestry_request]}]
                ancestors = [f"{item['resourceId']['type']}s/{item['resourceId']['id']}"
                    for item in ancestry if item["resourceId"]["type"] in ("folder", "organization")]
                complete = True
                for policy_scope in [project_scope, *ancestors]:
                    kind = "firewall_policy" if policy_scope == project_scope else "firewall_policy_association"
                    inventory = self.collections.get((kind, policy_scope))
                    if (not inventory or inventory["status"] not in ("collected", "empty") or
                        not inventory.get("source_requests")):
                        complete = False
                        break
                    if kind == "firewall_policy_association" and inventory["items"]:
                        complete = False
                        break
                    if kind == "firewall_policy" and any(
                        item.get("_provenance", {}).get("representation") != "full" or
                        not isinstance(item.get("associations", []), list) or item.get("associations")
                        for item in inventory["items"]):
                        complete = False
                        break
                    project_evidence.append({"path": f"collections.{kind}[{policy_scope}]",
                        "source_requests": inventory["source_requests"]})
                networks = self.collections.get(("network", project_scope))
                if networks and any(item.get("firewallPolicy") not in (None, "") for item in networks["items"]):
                    complete = False
                if complete:
                    unaffected_projects.append(project_scope)
                    project_ancestors[project_scope] = ancestors
                    evidence.extend(project_evidence)
            if unaffected_projects:
                metadata["network_context"] = {"gcp": {"firewall_hierarchy": {
                    "status": "collected", "complete": True, "policies": [],
                    "unaffected_projects": unaffected_projects, "project_ancestors": project_ancestors,
                    "source_evidence": evidence}}}
        from .gcp_appengine_versions import approved_version_maxima
        appengine_policy = approved_version_maxima(self.options, self.scopes)
        if appengine_policy is not None:
            metadata["appengine_version_policy"] = appengine_policy
        from .gcp_compliance_wave import policy_metadata
        metadata.update(policy_metadata(self.options, self.scopes))
        if self.sw52_native_mode:
            metadata["sw52_native"] = self.sw52_native
        if self.psc_owner_policy is not None:
            from peaso.gcp_psc_policy import OPTION as PSC_OPTION, normalize as normalize_psc_policy
            metadata[PSC_OPTION] = normalize_psc_policy(self.psc_owner_policy, self.scopes)
        if self.audit_owner_policy is not None:
            from peaso.gcp_data_access_policy import OPTION, normalize_owner_policy
            metadata[OPTION] = normalize_owner_policy(self.audit_owner_policy, self.scopes)
        # Preserve exactly the user's selection; resolved scopes and ancestry are
        # separately explicit and every collection is individually scoped.
        snapshot_scopes = (self.scopes or ["*"]) if self.auto_scopes else self.requested_scopes
        snapshot = make_snapshot("gcp", snapshot_scopes, envelopes, metadata=sanitize(metadata))
        self.progress("error" if self.auth_error else "completed", complete=True)
        return snapshot

def scope_jobs(self, scope):
        jobs = super().scope_jobs(scope)

        window = self.audit_window
        terms = ' OR '.join(f'log_id("cloudaudit.googleapis.com/{name}")' for name in window['classes'])
        methods = ' OR '.join(f'protoPayload.methodName="{name}"' for name in DETECTOR_METHODS)
        expression = f'timestamp >= "{window["start"]}" AND timestamp < "{window["end"]}" AND ({terms}) AND ({methods})'
        body = {'resourceNames': [scope], 'filter': expression, 'orderBy': 'timestamp asc', 'pageSize': min(self.page_size, 1000)}
        def project_only(row):
            if not isinstance(row, dict):
                raise ReadError('malformed', 'malformed_audit_entry')
            payload = row.get('protoPayload')
            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                raise ReadError('malformed', 'malformed_audit_payload')
            # Strict projection: never retain request/response bodies or tokens.
            auth, status, metadata = payload.get('authenticationInfo'), payload.get('status'), payload.get('requestMetadata')
            log_name, insert_id = row.get('logName'), row.get('insertId')
            identity = f'{log_name}#{insert_id}' if isinstance(log_name, str) and isinstance(insert_id, str) else None
            return {'name': identity, 'insertId': insert_id, 'timestamp': row.get('timestamp'),
                    'logName': row.get('logName'), 'resource': {'type': (row.get('resource') or {}).get('type'),
                        'labels': {'project_id': ((row.get('resource') or {}).get('labels') or {}).get('project_id')}},
                    'protoPayload': {'@type': payload.get('@type'), 'serviceName': payload.get('serviceName'),
                        'resourceName': payload.get('resourceName'), 'methodName': payload.get('methodName'),
                        'authenticationInfo': {'principalEmail': auth.get('principalEmail') if isinstance(auth, dict) else None},
                        'status': {'code': status.get('code') if isinstance(status, dict) else None},
                        'requestMetadata': {'callerIp': metadata.get('callerIp') if isinstance(metadata, dict) else None}}}
        def fetch():
            yield from self.pages(URL, scope, key='entries', method='POST', page_size_key=None,
                body=body, transform=project_only)
        jobs.append(('audit_log', scope, 'logging', fetch))
        return jobs

def _bound_inherited_sinks(item, index):
    """Collector-proven complete ancestor sink chain for this exact project."""
    scope = context_scope(index)
    project_id = get(item, "projectId", str)
    name = optional(item, "name", "", str)
    if not project_id or (name and not re.fullmatch(r"projects/[1-9][0-9]*", name)):
        raise Unavailable("malformed project identity")
    aliases = {project_id}
    if name:
        aliases.add(name.split("/", 1)[1])
    if scope != "projects/" + project_id and scope != name:
        raise Unavailable("project identity differs from evaluation scope")
    ancestry = list_of_objects(get(item, "_ancestry", list))
    if not ancestry:
        raise Unavailable("project ancestry is empty")
    chain, seen, organization_seen = [], set(), False
    for position, row in enumerate(ancestry):
        resource = get(row, "resourceId", dict)
        kind, identifier = get(resource, "type", str), get(resource, "id", str)
        if position == 0:
            if kind != "project" or identifier not in aliases:
                raise Unavailable("foreign project ancestry root")
            continue
        if (kind not in ("folder", "organization") or not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", identifier)
                or organization_seen or (kind, identifier) in seen):
            raise Unavailable("malformed project ancestry chain")
        seen.add((kind, identifier))
        chain.append(kind + "s/" + identifier)
        organization_seen = kind == "organization"
    coverage = get(get(item, "_coverage", dict), "_inherited_sinks", dict)
    if (get(coverage, "status", str) != "collected"
            or get(coverage, "collection_status", str) != "collected"
            or get(coverage, "ancestors", list) != chain):
        raise Unavailable("inherited sink coverage does not match ancestry")
    refs = get(coverage, "source_requests", list)
    if (any(not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref for ref in refs)
            or len(set(refs)) != len(refs) or len(refs) < len(chain)):
        raise Unavailable("inherited sink request provenance incomplete")
    provenance = get(item, "_provenance", dict)
    project_refs = get(provenance, "source_requests", list)
    if not set(refs) <= set(project_refs):
        raise Unavailable("ancestor sink requests absent from project provenance")
    metadata = get(get(index, "context", dict), "metadata", dict)
    request_rows = list_of_objects(get(metadata, "source_requests", list))
    requests = {get(row, "id", str): row for row in request_rows}
    if len(requests) != len(request_rows):
        raise Unavailable("duplicate source request identity")
    ancestry_url = "https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v1/" + scope + ":getAncestry"
    if not any(ref in requests and get(requests[ref], "method", str) == "POST"
               and get(requests[ref], "url", str) == ancestry_url
               and get(requests[ref], "scope", str) == scope
               and get(requests[ref], "status", str) == "collected" for ref in project_refs):
        raise Unavailable("project ancestry source request unverified")
    for ancestor in chain:
        expected_url = "https://logging.googleapis.com/v2/" + ancestor + "/sinks"
        if not any(ref in requests and get(requests[ref], "method", str) == "GET"
                   and get(requests[ref], "url", str) == expected_url
                   and get(requests[ref], "scope", str) == ancestor
                   and get(requests[ref], "status", str) == "collected" for ref in refs):
            raise Unavailable("ancestor sink source request unverified")
    for ref in refs:
        if (ref not in requests or get(requests[ref], "status", str) != "collected"
                or get(requests[ref], "method", str) != "GET"
                or get(requests[ref], "scope", str) not in chain
                or get(requests[ref], "url", str) !=
                    "https://logging.googleapis.com/v2/" + get(requests[ref], "scope", str) + "/sinks"):
            raise Unavailable("foreign or incomplete ancestor sink source")
    sinks = list_of_objects(get(item, "_inherited_sinks", list))
    seen_sinks = set()
    for sink in sinks:
        ancestor, sink_name = get(sink, "ancestor", str), get(sink, "name", str)
        if sink_name in seen_sinks:
            raise Unavailable("duplicate inherited sink identity")
        seen_sinks.add(sink_name)
        if (ancestor not in chain or not sink_name.startswith(ancestor + "/sinks/")
                or not sink_name[len(ancestor) + len("/sinks/"):]
                or "/" in sink_name[len(ancestor) + len("/sinks/"):]):
            raise Unavailable("foreign inherited sink identity")
    return sinks, chain

def gcp_effective_boolean_constraint(index, constraint):
    """Resolve an effective boolean policy only for this exact project/constraint.

    Imported snapshots retain the provider's policy name independently of the
    collection wrapper. A numeric project alias needs the producer's CRM read
    binding and its matching request trace; the policy payload is not an alias
    authority.
    """
    import re
    from .facts import Unavailable, complete_items
    envelopes = index.get("collections", {}).get("org_policy_effective", [])
    if not isinstance(envelopes, list) or len(envelopes) != 1 or not isinstance(envelopes[0], dict):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy scope ambiguous")
    scope = envelopes[0].get("scope")
    if not isinstance(scope, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"projects/[^/:%]+", scope):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy project scope unavailable")
    context = index.get("context")
    if (not isinstance(context, dict) or context.get("scope") != scope
            or context.get("provider") != "gcp"):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy context scope mismatch")
    policies = [p for p in complete_items(index, "org_policy_effective") if get(p, "constraint", str) == constraint]
    if len(policies) != 1:
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy missing or ambiguous: " + constraint)
    policy = policies[0]
    suffix = "/policies/" + constraint
    name = get(policy, "name", str)
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.endswith(suffix):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy name/constraint mismatch")
    parent = name[:-len(suffix)]
    provenance = optional(policy, "_provenance", {}, dict)
    if not isinstance(provenance, dict) or (optional(provenance, "scope", None, str) not in (None, scope)):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy provenance scope mismatch")
    alias = optional(policy, "project_alias", None, dict)
    if parent == scope:
        if alias is not None:
            raise Unavailable("unexpected effective org policy alias")
    else:
        if (not re.fullmatch(r"projects/[1-9][0-9]*", parent)
                or not isinstance(alias, dict)
                or get(alias, "requested_scope", str) != scope
                or get(alias, "project_id", str) != scope.split("/", 1)[1]
                or get(alias, "canonical_name", str) != parent
                or get(alias, "source_operation", str) != "projects.get"
                or not isinstance(get(alias, "source_request", str), str)
                or not get(alias, "source_request", str)):
            raise Unavailable("effective org policy project alias unresolved")
        requests = optional(get(context, "metadata", dict), "source_requests", [], list)
        if not isinstance(requests, list):
            raise Unavailable("effective org policy alias request trace missing")
        expected_url = "https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v3/" + scope
        matches = [entry for entry in requests if isinstance(entry, dict)
                   and get(entry, "id", str) == get(alias, "source_request", str)]
        if (len(matches) != 1 or get(matches[0], "url", str) != expected_url
                or get(matches[0], "method", str) != "GET"
                or get(matches[0], "scope", str) != scope
                or get(matches[0], "status", str) != "collected"):
            raise Unavailable("effective org policy alias request unverified")
    # An evaluated Policy with no spec/rules means nothing is set anywhere in
    # the hierarchy: a boolean constraint is then not enforced.
    spec = optional(policy, "spec", {}, dict)
    rules = list_of_objects(optional(spec, "rules", [], list))
    if any(set(rule) - {"enforce", "_coverage"} or set(optional(rule, "_coverage", {}, dict)) - {"enforce"} for rule in rules):
        raise Unavailable("conditional or non-boolean effective org policy rule: " + constraint)
    values = {get(rule, "enforce", bool) for rule in rules}
    if len(values) > 1:
        raise Unavailable("contradictory effective org policy rules: " + constraint)
    return values == {True}, name

def _audit(index, item):
    context, env, rows = _inventory(index, 'audit_log', item)
    coverage = get(env, 'audit_coverage', dict)
    if get(coverage, 'complete', bool) is not True or get(coverage, 'all_pages', bool) is not True:
        raise Unavailable('audit entry coverage incomplete')
    start, end = _time(get(coverage, 'start', str)), _time(get(coverage, 'end', str))
    if start > end:
        raise Unavailable('invalid audit coverage interval')
    normalized = []
    project = context['scope'].split('/', 1)[1]
    seen = set()
    for row in rows:
        identity = get(row, 'insertId', str)
        if not identity or identity in seen:
            raise Unavailable('audit identity missing or duplicated')
        seen.add(identity)
        log_name = get(row, 'logName', str)
        if not log_name.startswith(context['scope'] + '/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2F'):
            raise Unavailable('audit log provenance or project mismatch')
        if get(row, 'resource.labels.project_id', str) != project:
            raise Unavailable('foreign audit resource')
        timestamp = _time(get(row, 'timestamp', str))
        if not start <= timestamp <= end:
            raise Unavailable('audit event outside covered interval')
        method = get(row, 'protoPayload.methodName', str)
        principal = get(row, 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail', str)
        code = get(row, 'protoPayload.status.code', int)
        if not method or not principal or code < 0:
            raise Unavailable('malformed audit method, principal or status')
        normalized.append((timestamp, method, principal, code, row))
    return context, coverage, normalized
